study.question: Can auxiliary-owned item/action target and history-value embeddings recover auxiliary predictive quality while retaining the click advantage of primary-owned item embeddings, without rewriting the primary-owned history selector?
study.hypothesis: Observed item-gradient isolation improves click but deprives rare auxiliary tasks of useful learned item representations. Giving the auxiliary group a separately trainable item/action representation may relieve this representation bottleneck while avoiding direct auxiliary updates to click item geometry. Context remains shared to preserve the already-supported contextual path. This is a mechanism hypothesis, not measured evidence of gradient conflict or an originality claim.

nearest_work.difference: STEM uses shared and per-task embedding tables with expert gating and cross-task forward exchange. Here only item/action tables are split into click and one auxiliary group; context remains shared and primary-conditioned sequence weights stay unchanged. No new embedding-privatization claim.

Author code inspected: expert outputs from other tasks are detached before task gating. We inherit no STEM implementation; direct auxiliary target/history-value lookup replaces an embedding-gradient gate while preserving local DIN selection.

INFNet sections 3.1-3.2 use categorical, sequential and task tokens with proxy interactions. This study keeps the existing selector and changes embedding ownership; no proxy or task-token stack is implemented.

Inherits the local field-adapted DIN pooling and task towers through the incumbent; adds grouped private values and target embeddings, while keeping click-owned task-row scoring from later local trials.

The prior model scales auxiliary gradients into shared item tables. The new candidate redirects auxiliary item learning into a separate table set instead; it does not change auxiliary BCE weights or tune another gradient scale.

inherited_components: Frozen host feature construction, label semantics, official_offline visibility and training/scoring contracts
Incumbent FeatureEmbeddingDict, masked target-conditioned DIN interaction inputs, score trunk [128,32], primary-only selector-input gradients, task score rows, towers [128,64] and shared context
Original primary parameter creation order, reset and equal initial score rows; cloning occurs afterwards with no RNG draws
No architecture or numerical performance imported from external sources
study.proposed_difference: Clone only categorical item/action embedding modules after the inherited reset, with identical initial values and no checkpoint use. Three auxiliary heads jointly learn these private target/history-value embeddings; primary click uses original embeddings. All task selectors still read primary item geometry and retain their original task-specific readout gradients. Four replacement modes isolate private supervised adaptation, a fixed initial basis, detached primary values, and shared joint values. All variants allocate and look up the same clone set, but active capacity and backward compute are explicitly different.
predictions: tied_primary_items reproduces g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary click AUC 0.660163362657485 and auxiliary metrics; tied_joint_items reproduces g3-r0004-joint_hook_control click AUC 0.6583679240765704. Check outputs/gradients first; these are reproducibility expectations, not newly measured results.

private_aux_items improves auxiliary mean AUC by at least 0.05 over tied_primary_items while click loses at most 0.0005; it also approaches tied_joint_items auxiliary mean within 0.01. These are prospective mechanism guardrails, not revised model-selection scores.
private_aux_items beats fixed_aux_items on auxiliary mean AUC; otherwise learned specialization is unnecessary in this implementation.
The private lookup/pooling path adds allocated embedding memory and forward work; no efficiency advantage is predicted without measurement.
falsifiers: Endpoint controls fail to reproduce their corresponding archived functional/gradient behavior: comparison validity fails before any mechanism interpretation.
Private learned values do not improve auxiliary metrics relative to tied_primary_items or fixed_aux_items.
Auxiliary recovery occurs only with a click AUC loss greater than 0.0005 versus tied_primary_items; this implementation has not resolved the tradeoff.
Private candidate cannot approach the joint-control auxiliary mean within 0.01, or exceeds the per-trial time/resource limit.
Paired later seeds reverse the apparent advantage; a one-seed screen is insufficient for repeated support.
alternative_explanations: Additional active embedding capacity rather than task ownership explains improvement; allocated-capacity controls cannot fully remove this.
Sparse Adagrad accumulator dynamics and one-pass convergence, rather than conflicting semantic preferences, explain earlier gradient-scale tradeoffs.
Shared context gradients mediate click differences despite complete direct item isolation.
Selector/value geometric mismatch limits private representation learning.
Rare auxiliary positive counts and one training seed cause variation; repeated user exposures are correlated.
Auxiliary labels and released offline history visibility differ from production attribution/maturity; no production point-in-time conclusion follows.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary: 367.39s, 5.70GB peak; latest four runs 364.10-372.86s. Frozen protocol estimated unit 481.35s and cap 1203.37s. Plan 600s each for four modes (~2400s); worst permitted execution 4813.48s total, plus all preparation and checks. Host measures actual costs.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve at least 12000s for endpoint debugging, matched controls, and two additional paired seeds for the consequential candidate and endpoint controls if host phases permit. These are future allocations, not executions or seed overrides in this proposal.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least 12000s for final validation/repetition and a frozen comparison suite. No held-out score is requested now; freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes and suite before host-authorized closed assessment.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not train or install here. Submit four standalone sources for host execution only. Stop each run at the frozen 1203.37s cap or resource failure; retain failed costs and do not auto-retry unknown states. Stop new experiments when remaining declared budget cannot cover a complete admissible unit plus reserves. Never increase limits.

variants.name: private_aux_items
variants.note: Trainable private item/action tables, initialized as exact copies after inherited reset; shared by three auxiliary heads. Primary selector, shared context and all tower widths retained. Auxiliaries train their private target/history values and score rows, never the primary item tables or score trunk. No measured result yet.

variants.name: fixed_aux_items
variants.note: Same copied item/action tables and lookups, but private embeddings run under no_grad and remain at initialization. Tests learned adaptation beyond a fixed initial basis; this is not an incumbent reproduction. Allocated capacity matches the candidate; active capacity and backward cost differ.

variants.name: tied_primary_items
variants.note: Auxiliary heads read detached current primary target/history values; copied tables allocated and looked up but unused. Functional and gradient reproduction control for g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary, with added allocation/forward cost. Must reproduce archived metrics before interpretation.

variants.name: tied_joint_items
variants.note: Auxiliary heads read live current primary target/history values; copied tables allocated and looked up but unused. Functional and gradient reproduction control for g3-r0004-joint_hook_control and g3-r0003-embedding_joint. Default summed BCE replaces the explicit identical unit-weight hook; verify equivalence. Shared selector trunk remains click-owned.

evidence_review.observation: Initial task-feedback retrieval AUC 0.6554608 did not beat baseline 0.6555441; task item-only retrieval 0.6558818 was marginally higher. Primary-owned selector gradients gave 0.6576086 versus joint-feedback 0.6554608. Observed selector ownership mattered more than initial feedback conditioning.
evidence_review.limitations: One seed and interacting choices; no general architectural conclusion.

evidence_review.observation: Split auxiliary selectors gave click AUCs 0.6574206, 0.6567847 and 0.6578316; the approximately capacity-matched wide-primary control reached 0.6583679. Private selector learning did not establish benefit; this branch is not credited for the incumbent.
evidence_review.limitations: Differences in active capacity, random initialization and backward cost remain.

evidence_review.observation: Item-only gradient blocking reached click AUC 0.6601634 versus joint 0.6583679, but auxiliary AUCs dropped to 0.67982/0.72358/0.66262 from 0.84438/0.86367/0.86141. Blocking both groups gave click 0.6599039; context-only blocking 0.6591803. Shared context is retained while auxiliary item representation starvation motivates the new branch.
evidence_review.limitations: Single-seed controlled contrasts support an ownership sensitivity; they do not directly measure gradient conflicts or positive transfer versus single-task training.

evidence_review.observation: Partial item gradients 0.1/0.5 recovered auxiliary AUCs with click 0.6596625/0.6593366, below the isolated endpoint. Global auxiliary loss 0.1 gave click 0.6594593 and did not dominate local attenuation. Joint unit-hook control exactly reproduced joint AUC 0.6583679240765704. Tradeoff persists; no winning gradient-scale mechanism is established.
evidence_review.limitations: Same-seed endpoint reproductions are correctness evidence, not independent mechanism repetitions. Novel candidate outcomes are pending.

validation_plan.local: Syntax/AST and proposal schema checks only. Torch is absent and installations/training are forbidden; no dynamic forward/backward/masking result is claimed.
host_prerequisites: Verify all four initial prediction functions agree with the incumbent at copied initialization; compare common parameter tensors and RNG states.
Verify tied-primary/joint logits and corresponding common-parameter gradients match archived endpoints under the same batch and default summed BCE.

For private mode, isolate losses: click gradients reach original item/selector/context/tower, not private tables; auxiliary gradients reach private tables, shared context, their score rows/towers, not original item tables or selector trunk.
For fixed/tied modes, cloned tables must receive no gradients; register copies as nn.Embedding so host Adagrad grouping is preserved.

Test mixed, all-empty, and zero-length histories; perturb padded IDs and current target action while fixing authorized values; predictions must remain finite and invariant. Test training-mode Dice masking as well as inference.

Measure registered and gradient-active parameter counts, peak memory, train/validation wall/GPU seconds, processed examples, throughput and p50/p95 batch latency. No matched-compute efficiency claim from matched data passes.
validation_plan.analysis: Full validation click AUC selects models. Report all four AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately. Reuse declared history bins (empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64), with samples/positives/negatives and insufficient-slice flags. Treat additional diagnostics as exploratory. Paired user-cluster bootstrap and paired seeds only through host-authorized interfaces; never claim significance from this screen.
